name: green-zone-fvg-sb-exclusive
note: HALF ONE OF A PAIR — see green-zone-fvg-sb-disabled, and the pair guard in tests/drawing-geometry.test.ts. Super OrderBlock splits the Pine's single recoloured FVG box into two outputs because a zone's colour is a static style here: `FVG+ SB` takes the structure-breaking case and `FVG+` takes `not sbFvgUp`, which conversion note 7 claims are EXACTLY EXCLUSIVE. sbFvgUp means the confirmed pivot high sits strictly INSIDE the gap (high[2] < pivotTop < low) while bar s-1 closed above the pivot after dipping below it. The only pivot high is confirmed at bar 2 with value high[1]=112, carried forward by valuewhen. `fvg.up(0)` is true at exactly bars 5 and 8: bars 4, 6, 7 and 9 each have low EXACTLY equal to high[2] (108/118/120/128), so the gap is zero-width and no zone spawns. NOTE WHICH CONJUNCT DOES THAT WORK, because this fixture does NOT pin the other one: at min_size 0 `fvg.up`'s two conjuncts are redundant, and the size test `(low - high[2]) > 0` alone rejects every one of those four bars. Relaxing `low > high[2]` to `low >= high[2]` is therefore an EQUIVALENT MUTANT here and this fixture survives it — verified, not assumed. Separating the two conjuncts needs a second call at a non-zero min_size, which is what green-zone-fvg-stdlib exists to do via `fvg.up(1)`; that coverage is deliberately not duplicated here. Bar 5 qualifies as SB — close[4]=115>112, low[4]=108<112, high[3]=110<112, low[5]=114>112 — and yields x1=3, top=low[5]=114, bottom=high[3]=110. Bar 8 fails SB on low[7]=120 which is NOT below 112, so it falls to the plain output with x1=6, top=low[8]=127, bottom=high[6]=122. Neither zone is straddled through bar 9, so both ride to the live edge open and unmitigated. THIS HALF ALONE PROVES NOTHING ABOUT EXCLUSIVITY — it shows a partition, not that the partition is lossless. The paired fixture flips plotSB and the guard asserts the concatenated item multiset is identical across the two, which is what the prose claim actually asserts.
source:
indicator("SBX", shorttitle="SBX", overlay=true)
p = input.int(1, "Pivot Lookup", minval=1, maxval=5)
plotSB = input.bool(true, "Plot Structure Breaking FVG")
pivotTop = pivot.last_high(p, p)
sbFvgUp = plotSB and close[1] > pivotTop and low[1] < pivotTop and high[2] < pivotTop and low > pivotTop
plotzone(fvg.up(0) and sbFvgUp, fvg.up_top(), fvg.up_bottom(), "FVG+ SB", offset=-2, extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.straddle, max_kept=10)
plotzone(fvg.up(0) and not sbFvgUp, fvg.up_top(), fvg.up_bottom(), "FVG+", offset=-2, extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.straddle, max_kept=10)
